Name: Lux's Sprite Mod
Author: thisislux
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zK91csS.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/MT4wtp0.png[/img]
                                                                    
[size=3]A resprite content pack for Stardew Valley to improve the look of all 80 cooked dish sprites and 42 crop sprites + 13 foods from Stardew Valley Expanded![/size]
[b]

[size=6]Installation[/size][/b]

[size=3]If you don't already have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI mod loader[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3130]Scale Up 2[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] mods, you will need to download those first, then copy and paste the contents of the zip folder into your SDV Mods folder. [/size]

[size=3]If you would like to select between [/size][url=https://twitter.com/thisislux/status/1434985003650203651][size=3]uneven sprite scaling[/size][/url][size=3] and the smaller but pixel-perfect alternative, or to enable/disable food and crops independently, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is recommended, and this also goes in your SDV Mods folder. Alternatively, you can edit the config.json file.

If you have changed something in the config menu, assets will reload after leaving the current map.

LSM is for SDV 1.6+ only, and will not work in older versions of SDV.[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]
